candidate.definition_en: A fungal growth that typically takes the form of a domed cap on a stalk.
candidate.explanation_ar: فِطر (عيش الغراب) له ساق وقبعة مستديرة، وتؤكل بعض أنواعه.

senses.definition_en: A fungus with a round top and a stem, some types of which can be eaten as food.
senses.definition_ar: فِطر ذو قبعة مستديرة وساق، تؤكل بعض أنواعه.
examples: We picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
He found a large white mushroom under the tree.
